proof_body:
by
  intro p _ hp2 u a hu hau
  have hP := (Fact.out : p.Prime)
  have ha : ‖a‖ = 1 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : ‖a‖ < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (PadicInt.norm_le_one a) hne
    have h2 : ‖a ^ 2‖ < 1 := by
      rw [norm_pow]; nlinarith [norm_nonneg a]
    have h3 : ‖a ^ 2 - u‖ = 1 := by
      have := PadicInt.norm_add_eq_max_of_ne (q := a ^ 2) (r := -u) (by rw [norm_neg, hu]; exact h2.ne)
      rw [← sub_eq_add_neg, norm_neg, hu, max_eq_right h2.le] at this
      exact this
    linarith
  have h2n : ‖(2 : PadicInt p)‖ = 1 := by
    have := PadicInt.norm_natCast_eq_one_iff (p := p) (n := 2)
    have h' := this.2 (((Nat.prime_two.coprime_iff_not_dvd).2 (fun h => hp2 ((Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq Nat.prime_two hP).1 h).symm)).symm)
    simpa using h'
  let F : Polynomial (PadicInt p) := Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C u
  have hF : ∀ z, Polynomial.eval z F = z ^ 2 - u := by intro z; simp [F]
  have hF' : Polynomial.eval a (Polynomial.derivative F) = 2 * a := by
    simp [F]; left; exact one_add_one_eq_two
  have hl : ‖Polynomial.aeval a F‖ < ‖Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.derivative F)‖ ^ 2 := by
    simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF, hF', norm_mul, h2n, ha]; simpa using hau
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hd, _, _⟩ := hensels_lemma hl
  simp only [Polynomial.coe_aeval_eq_eval, hF, hF', norm_mul, h2n, ha, one_mul] at hz hd
  exact ⟨z, sub_eq_zero.1 hz, hd⟩
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], p ≠ 2 → ∀ (u a : PadicInt p), ‖u‖ = 1 → ‖a ^ 2 - u‖ < 1 → ∃ z : PadicInt p, z ^ 2 = u ∧ ‖z - a‖ < 1
